data.title: Sol-Gel Technologies to Host Conference Call to Discuss Top-Line Results from Pivotal Phase 3 Clinical Trial of SGT-610 in Gorlin Syndrome
data.description:
NESS ZIONA, Israel, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sol-Gel Technologies, Ltd. (NASDAQ: SLGL), a dermatology company, pioneering treatments for patients with rare and severe skin conditions, today announced that it will host a conference call on Monday, November 30, 2026, at 8:00am Eastern Time to discuss top-line results from its pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial (SGT-610-01) evaluating SGT-610 (patidegib gel, 2%) for the prevention of basal cell carcinoma lesions in adult patients with Gorlin syndrome. The Company plans to issue a press release announcing the top-line results at 7:00am Eastern Time on Monday, November 30, 2026, prior to the start of the conference call.

To access the live webcast of the call, please click here or visit the "Events" section of Sol-Gel’s website. To access the call by phone, please use this registration link, and you will be provided with dial in details. A replay of the call will be available approximately 2 hours after the conclusion of the call and archived for 90 days under the "Events " section of the Company's website at http://www.sol-gel.com.

About Sol-Gel Technologies

Sol-Gel is a specialized dermatology company advancing innovative therapies for rare and serious skin diseases. Its lead investigational candidate, SGT-610 (patidegib gel, 2%), is a Phase 3, orphan- and breakthrough-designated topical hedgehog inhibitor being developed for the prevention of new basal cell carcinoma (BCC) lesions in patients with Gorlin syndrome, with the potential to offer an improved safety profile relative to oral hedgehog inhibitors. Subject to regulatory approval in Gorlin syndrome, SGT-610 may also represent a future opportunity in high-frequency BCC. Sol-Gel is also advancing SGT-210, an investigational topical EGFR inhibitor for indications with significant unmet need, and has developed two FDA-approved dermatology products, TWYNEO® and EPSOLAY®.

data.title: Ricky Martin and Mya Come Together to Perform at AHF’s Sold out 40th Anniversary World AIDS Day Concert
data.description:
Ricky Martin and Mya Come Together to Perform at AHF’s Sold out 40th Anniversary World AIDS Day Concert

Multi-award-winning global star and philanthropist, Ricky Martin and Grammy Award winning singer, songwriter and producer, Mya will come together to perform at the Annual World AIDS Day benefit concert presented by AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF). Scheduled for the evening of Monday, November 30, 2026, at the Kia Forum in Inglewood, California, the sold-out event will also commemorate the organizations 40th anniversary of global impact in the fight against HIV/AIDS.

As a part of the evening’s festivities the organization will also present the Dolores Huerta Social Justice Award. The award, named in recognition of Huerta's extraordinary lifetime commitment to civil rights, social justice, and community empowerment, will recognize individuals whose leadership, courage, and service reflect the principles that have defined her remarkable legacy. The recipient of this year’s inaugural award will be the Honorable Lindsey Horvath, Los Angeles County Supervisor, Third District.

Beyond their global recognition as artists, both Ricky and Mya continue to use their platform for important causes. Mya, is involved in several charitable and social causes, particularly HIV/AIDS awareness, youth empowerment, animal welfare, and healthy living. She joined AHF in 2023 to perform to a packed audience in Atlanta, Georgia for the organizations annual AIDS Walk 5K & Music Festival, helping to raise close to $1 million dollars in the support for HIV/AIDS prevention and treatment services in the local community. Martin continues to bring greater awareness and support for various issues around HIV/AIDS, human trafficking, and LGBTQIA+ rights. He joined AHF in 2023 to perform to a sold-out crowd as the headliner for the organization’s World AIDS Day concert at the Watsco Center at the University of Miami (UM) in Coral Gables, Florida.

AHF is returning to the Kia Forum to present this year’s commemoration and celebrate its 40th anniversary. AHF held its event at the iconic venue in 2021 when celebrating the organization’s 35th anniversary, which featured Christina Aguliera and Jennifer Hudson.

WHAT:

AHF’S 40th ANNIVERSARY AND ANNUAL WORLD AIDS DAY BENEFIT CONCERT

 

WHEN:

MONDAY, NOVEMBER 30, 2026 7:00PM PST

NOTE: MEDIA CHECK-IN WILL START AT 5:30PM PST

 

WHERE:

KIA FORUM, 3900 W. MANCHESTER BLVD, INGLEWOOD, CA

 

WHO:

RICKY MARTIN, MULTI-AWARD-WINNING GLOBAL STAR AND PHILANTHROPIST

MYA, GRAMMY AWARD WINNING SINGER, SONGWRITER AND PRODYCER

THE HONORABLE LINDSEY HORVATH. LOS ANGELES COUNTY SUPERVISOR, THIRD DISTRICT

MICHAEL WEINSTEIN, AHF PRESIDENT

DR. CONDESSA CURLEY, AHF BOARD CHAIR

THOUSANDS OF ATTENDEES INCLUDING INDIVIDUALS LIVING WITH HIV

OBTAINING MEDIA CREDENTIALS: FOR SECURITY PURPOSES, ALL MEDIA PLANNING TO COVER THE EVENT PLEASE SEND AN EMAIL TO GED KENSLEA AT GED.KENSLEA@AHF.ORG. CREDENTIALS CAN BE PICKED UP STARTING AT 5:30PM PST AT THE MEDIA CHECK-IN TABLE AT THE MAIN ENTRANCE TO THE KIA FORUM.

Commemorated annually on December 1st, World AIDS Day is an international observance held to raise awareness of the HIV/AIDS epidemic, show support for people living with HIV, and remember those who have died from AIDS-related illnesses. Since, 2016, AHF’s World AIDS Day commemoration, under the slogan of Keep the Promise, has been presented in cities across the country, including Dallas, Atlanta, New York, Washington, D.C. and Houston. To heighten broader public awareness to the on-going impact of the global epidemic, and the work still to be done, the organization has previously worked with acclaimed director/choreographer, Debbie Allen to produce the show and over the last decade, partnered with a diverse array of performing artists such as Mariah Carey, Common, Janet Jackson, Patti LaBelle, Jennifer Holliday, Diana Ross and Gladys Knight to perform at the annual event.

According to recent statistics from U.N. AIDS, there are over 41 million individuals living with HIV and 1.2 million have been newly diagnosed. Domestically, approximately 1.2 million people live with HIV in the U.S., and about 13% of them do not know they have it, according to HIV.gov.

Founded in 1987, AIDS Healthcare Foundation started as a network of hospices and grassroots advocacy in Los Angeles. It was originally known as the AIDS Hospice Foundation before changing its name to the AIDS Healthcare Foundation in 1990. To date, AHF has healthcare and wellness centers in 50 countries and 19 domestic locations including the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico. AHF provides direct HIV/AIDS services to over 3.2 million individuals in care.

AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF), the world’s largest HIV/AIDS healthcare organization, provides cutting-edge medicine and advocacy to more than 3.2 million individuals across 50 countries, including the U.S. and in Africa, Latin America/Caribbean, the Asia/Pacific Region, and Eastern Europe. In January 2025, AHF received the MLK, Jr. Social Justice Award, The King Center’s highest recognition for an organization leading work in the social justice arena. To learn more about AHF, visit us online at AIDShealth.org, find us on Facebook, and follow us on Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok.

Located in Inglewood, California, the Kia Forum is the only arena-sized venue in the country dedicated to music and entertainment, delivering a superior experience for artists and fans alike. The iconic venue hosts a diverse range of premier events, featuring the biggest names in music and entertainment, award shows, combat sports, and more. Fans at the Kia Forum enjoy approximately 8,000 square feet of event-level hospitality offerings, including merchandise and food and beverage options. A tinted glass wall separates this concession area from the arena, ensuring fans do not miss a moment of the show. A 40,000-square-foot outdoor terrace wraps around the perimeter of the building and offers comfortable furnishings and food and beverage options from some of SoCal’s most celebrated brands. Designed with entertainers and performers in mind, Kia Forum Backstage includes star-caliber dressing rooms that provide unparalleled comfort. The Kia Forum received Pollstar's "Arena of the Decade" award in 2022 and was named the top West Coast arena in 2025 by Pollstar and Billboard magazines. thekiaforum.com | Instagram | Facebook | Twitter

data.title: SunPower Receives Notice of Deficiency from Nasdaq Related to Delayed Filing of Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for Third Quarter 2026
data.description:
OREM, Utah, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SunPower Inc. (Nasdaq “SPWR”) today announced that it received a deficiency notification letter from the Listing Qualifications staff of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) on November 23, 2026 (the "Notice"). The Notice indicated that the Company was not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) (the “Listing Rule”) because it did not timely file its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 27, 2026 (the “Q3 Form 10-Q”). The Listing Rules require Nasdaq-listed companies to timely file all required periodic reports with the SEC. The Notice has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company’s common stock or warrants.

In accordance with Nasdaq’s listing rules, the Company has 60 calendar days after the Notice to submit a plan to regain compliance with the Listing Rule. The Company continues to work diligently to complete its Q3 Form 10-Q. The Company intends to file its Q3 Form 10-Q as promptly as possible to retain compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1).

About SunPower
SunPower Inc. (Nasdaq: SPWR) is a leading residential solar services provider in North America. The Company’s digital platform and installation services support energy needs for customers wishing to make the transition to a more energy-efficient lifestyle. For more information visit www.sunpower.com.

data.title: VisionWave Holdings, Inc. Announces Closing of $2.0 Million Registered Direct Offering
data.description:
WEST HOLLYWOOD, Calif., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- VisionWave Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: VWAV) (the “Company”), a technology company focused on advanced defense, autonomous systems and related technologies, today announced the closing of its previously announced registered direct offering with institutional investors for the purchase and sale of approximately $2.0 million of shares of Common Stock (or pre-funded warrants in lieu thereof) together with accompanying investor warrants at a price of $0.19 per Common Unit.

The offering consisted of the sale of 10,526,313 Common Units (or Pre-Funded Units), each consisting of (i) one (1) share of Common Stock or one (1) Pre-Funded Warrant and (ii) one (1) Registered Common Warrant to purchase one (1) share of Common Stock per warrant at an exercise price of $0.57. The public offering price per Common Unit was $0.19 (or $0.18 for each Pre-Funded Unit, which is equal to the public offering price per Common Unit sold in the offering minus an exercise price of $0.01 per Pre-Funded Warrant). The Pre-Funded Warrants are immediately exercisable and may be exercised at any time until exercised in full. For each Pre-Funded Unit sold in the offering, the number of Common Units in the offering was decreased on a one-for-one basis. The initial exercise price of each Common Warrant is $0.57 per share of Common Stock or pursuant to an alternative cashless exercise option. The Common Warrants are exercisable immediately and expire 60 months after the initial issuance date.

Aggregate gross proceeds to the Company were approximately $2.0 million. The Company expects to use the net proceeds from the offering, together with its existing cash, for general corporate purposes, including partial repayment of the convertible debenture issued by the Company to YA II PN, Ltd. in the original principal amount of $10,000,000 on July 20, 2026 and working capital.

Following the closing of the offering, and after the exercise in full of the Pre-Funded Warrants issued in the offering and the issuance of 9,313,157 shares of Common Stock upon the exercise of certain Common Warrants, the Company has 41,260,663 shares of Common Stock issued and outstanding.

The Company has agreed not to issue shares of Common Stock under its standby equity purchase agreement for 30 days following the closing of the offering, and its outstanding convertible notes may not be converted during that period.

Aegis Capital Corp. acted as exclusive placement agent for the offering. Sheppard, Mullin, Richter & Hampton LLP acted as counsel to the Company. Kaufman & Canoles, P.C. acted as counsel to Aegis Capital Corp.

The registered direct offering was made pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3 (No. 333-297939) previously filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and declared effective by the SEC on September 1, 2026. A final prospectus supplement and accompanying prospectus describing the terms of the offering have been filed with the SEC and are available on the SEC’s website located at www.sec.gov. Electronic copies of the final prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus may be obtained by contacting Aegis Capital Corp., Attention: Syndicate Department, 1345 Avenue of the Americas, 27th floor, New York, NY 10105, by email at syndicate@aegiscap.com, or by telephone at +1 (212) 813-1010.

This press release shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy nor shall there be any sale of these securities in any state or jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any such state or jurisdiction.

About VisionWave Holdings, Inc.

VisionWave Holdings, Inc. Its portfolio includes the VARAN unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) platform and a suite of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and drone solutions, supported by sensing, perception, and autonomy technologies. Through technology development and strategic partnerships, VisionWave aims to deliver integrated ground and aerial systems that enhance situational awareness, support operational missions, and reduce personnel exposure to risk across military and civilian environments. data.title: Fulcrum Therapeutics Declares Special Cash Dividend in Connection with the Proposed Merger with Slate Medicines
data.description:
CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fulcrum Therapeutics, Inc. (“Fulcrum”) (Nasdaq: FULC) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend (the “Pre-Closing Cash Dividend”) in connection with the previously announced merger (the “Merger”) with Slate Medicines, Inc. (“Slate”) pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated August 16, 2026 (the “Merger Agreement”). The Pre-Closing Cash Dividend, which Fulcrum estimates will be an aggregate of up to approximately $275.7 million, or up to an estimated $3.6095 per share, will be payable in cash to holders of record of outstanding shares of Fulcrum common stock as of December 7, 2026. The estimated cash dividend is equal in the aggregate to an amount mutually agreed in good faith by Fulcrum and Slate by reference to the amount by which Fulcrum’s Net Cash (as determined pursuant to the Merger Agreement) is expected to exceed $20,300,000 as of the closing of the Merger. The estimated per share dividend is based on 76,381,948 shares of common stock outstanding as of November 25, 2026. The total actual distribution of the amount of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is scheduled to be paid to Fulcrum’s transfer agent on December 10, 2026 (the “Dividend Payment Date”), and may be higher or lower than the estimated amount. The transfer agent will distribute the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend to stockholders within a few days following the Dividend Payment Date.

Payment of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is subject to the final determination of Fulcrum’s Net Cash in accordance with the Merger Agreement. The estimated aggregate Pre-Closing Cash Dividend amount includes approximately $7.0 million of proceeds from the sale of Fulcrum’s early-stage fetal hemoglobin (“HbF”) assets to an unaffiliated third-party pharmaceutical company, which are expected to be funded into escrow prior to the closing of the Merger and credited to Fulcrum’s Net Cash for purposes of the Merger Agreement. The closing of the early-stage HbF assets sale is contingent upon consummation of the Merger (or in the event the Merger Agreement is terminated, upon receipt of any necessary approvals). If the anticipated $7.0 million of proceeds are not funded into escrow, the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend will be reduced to an estimated aggregate of $268.7 million, or an estimated $3.5178 per share. Closing of the Merger is expected to occur on or about December 11, 2026, assuming that the transaction is approved by Fulcrum’s stockholders and the satisfaction or waiver of all conditions under the Merger Agreement. Fulcrum’s stockholders will consider and vote upon approval of the Merger at the special meeting of Fulcrum’s stockholders scheduled for 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on December 3, 2026.

If you need assistance voting your shares or have questions regarding the special meeting of Fulcrum’s stockholders, please contact Fulcrum’s proxy solicitor, D.F. King & Co., Inc., at (800) 431-9643 (toll-free).

About Slate Medicines, Inc.

Slate Medicines is developing next-generation therapeutics designed to expand treatment options for migraine and other headache disorders. Slate’s mission is to offer migraine patients more complete freedom from their disease than is possible with the current standard of care. Slate is advancing a portfolio of potentially best-in-class therapeutics, led by SLTE-1009, a clinical stage anti-PACAP/VIP monoclonal antibody designed to enable subcutaneous, infrequent dosing. For more information, please visit www.slatemedicines.com. 

About Fulcrum Therapeutics, Inc.

Fulcrum Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that focused on developing small molecules to improve the lives of patients with rare hematological disorders. Fulcrum used proprietary technology to identify drug targets that can modulate gene expression to treat the known root cause of genetically defined diseases. For more information, visit www.fulcrumtx.com and follow it on X (@FulcrumTx) and LinkedIn.

data.title: GigaCloud Technology Inc to Participate in Two Investor Conferences in December
data.description:
EL MONTE, Calif., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GigaCloud Technology Inc (Nasdaq: GCT) (“GigaCloud” or the “Company”), a pioneer of global end-to-end B2B technology solutions for large parcel merchandise, today announced that Erica Wei, its Chief Financial Officer, will participate in two investor conferences in December.

UBS 30th Annual Global Technology and AI Conference 2026

  • December 2, 2026 – Scottsdale, Arizona.
  • One-one-one investor meetings.

ROTH 15th Annual Deer Valley Event

  • December 10-11, 2026 – Park City, Utah.
  • One-one-one investor meetings.

Investors wishing to schedule a meeting with GigaCloud should contact their UBS or ROTH representative, respectively, or PondelWilkinson at tkehrli@pondel.com.

About GigaCloud Technology Inc

GigaCloud Technology Inc is a pioneer of global end-to-end B2B technology solutions for large parcel merchandise. The Company’s B2B ecommerce platform, which it refers to as the “GigaCloud Marketplace,” integrates everything from discovery and payments to logistics tools into one easy-to-use platform. The Company’s global marketplace seamlessly connects manufacturers, primarily in Asia, with resellers, primarily in the U.S., Asia and Europe, to execute cross-border transactions with confidence, speed and efficiency. The Company offers a truly comprehensive solution that transports products from the manufacturer’s warehouse to the end customer’s doorstep, all at one fixed price. The Company first launched its marketplace in January 2019 by focusing on the global furniture market and has since expanded into additional categories such as home appliances and fitness equipment. For more information, please visit the Company’s website: https://investors.gigacloudtech.com/.

data.title: Canada Pumps Billions More For Battered Forest Industry
data.description:
By Paul Vieira

OTTAWA--Canada unveiled on Friday a multibillion-dollar plan to reverse the dwindling fortunes of the country's forest-products sector, which is struggling under the weight of U.S. tariffs and faces acute risks unless addressed.

Canada's Natural Resources Minister Tim Hodgson said the task at hand is to revitalize the sector and stop the flight of capital to the U.S. and elsewhere. Alongside hefty tariffs, Canadian officials acknowledged some of the forestry sector's challenges are homegrown, among them chronic underinvestment and regulatory overlap that thwarts access to cost-competitive fiber used in the production of pulp and paper.

For Hodgson's efforts, Canada has allocated an additional 6.5 billion Canadian dollars (US$4.5 billion) for forestry-sector improvements, building on C$3 billion provided in August 2025 to help with the fallout from U.S. tariffs. All told, the Canadian government has made available roughly C$33 billion in financing for all trade-exposed companies, and about C$10 billion in direct support for affected workers.

Most Canadian exports of softwood lumber - used in the construction of houses - face U.S. duties and tariffs of nearly 35%. Ottawa and Washington have engaged in a decades-long row about lumber products, with U.S. officials accusing Canada of unfairly subsidizing its forest industry.

Officials added forest-product exports have dropped 22% since President Trump imposed further duties on the sector. This has led to the closure of 12 Canadian sawmills, and output curtails in 40 other plants, the officials added.

Hodgson said the government wants to improve access to fibre, accelerate innovation in the sector, and drive domestic demand for Canadian forest products. "Business as usual is no longer an option for our forest sector," he said, adding the government's plan is meant to help the sector navigate current challenges and secure its future.

The additional money for Canada's forest sector is in response to findings from a government-appointed task force, which this year warned the industry faces an existential risk. "Continued inaction will accelerate capital flight, erode skilled workforces, destabilize rural and Indigenous communities, and forgo a generational opportunity to position Canada as a leader in the emerging global bioeconomy," the task force said.

Canada is home to nearly 10% of the world's forests, and about 40% of the country is covered by timberland. But the sector's economic heft has weakened considerably over the decades. Government data indicate that forest products account for about 1% of Canada's gross domestic product, down from a 3% level over two decades ago. Meanwhile, employment in the sector is about 40% below 2004 levels, and softwood-lumber production has declined by nearly a third from 2017 levels.

Of the C$6.5 billion made available, officials said about one-quarter of that cash will be focused on improving productivity at existing sawmills, while the remaining monies are expected to invest in new large-scale factories to accelerate the development of advanced forest products.
